title: Multivariate Balanced Data Splitting for rsample
text: example uses simulated data two skewed numeric variables two categorical variables. balanced_vfold_cv() takes columns balance balance. Categorical columns exact stratified exactly: fold, count level combination floor ceiling proportional share fold. group, counts groups, rows. balance_check() reports standardized mean difference (SMD) variable fold. SMD compares assessment set analysis set. also reports energy distance, compares whole multivariate distribution. function works rsample object, can compare balanced folds ordinary folds. Use autoplot() see SMD values. dashed lines -0.1 0.1.  folds work tune. must attach balancesample library(), tune finds function made folds name. balanced_initial_split() makes one balanced training/testing split.
code: library(balancesample)  set.seed(2026) n <- 400 d <- data.frame(   age = rgamma(n, shape = 4, rate = 0.1),   income = rlnorm(n, meanlog = 10, sdlog = 0.6),   diagnosis = sample(c("none", "mild", "severe"), n, TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.3, 0.1)),   site = sample(c("A", "B"), n, TRUE) ) d$outcome <- 0.05 * d$age + 0.3 * log(d$income) + rnorm(n) folds <- balanced_vfold_cv(   d,   v = 5,   balance = c(age, income, diagnosis),   exact = site ) folds #> # 5-fold balanced cross-validation (anticlust), stratified by site #> # A tibble: 5 × 2 #>   splits           id    #>   <list>           <chr> #> 1 <split [320/80]> Fold1 #> 2 <split [320/80]> Fold2 #> 3 <split [320/80]> Fold3 #> 4 <split [320/80]> Fold4 #> 5 <split [320/80]> Fold5 balance_check(folds) #> # Balance check: 5 splits, max |SMD| = 0.025, mean energy distance = 0.0203 #> # A tibble: 40 × 5 #>    id    variable  level  statistic     value #>    <chr> <chr>     <chr>  <chr>         <dbl> #>  1 Fold1 age       <NA>   smd       -0.000600 #>  2 Fold1 income    <NA>   smd       -0.000770 #>  3 Fold1 diagnosis mild   smd        0        #>  4 Fold1 diagnosis none   smd        0        #>  5 Fold1 diagnosis severe smd        0        #>  6 Fold1 site      A      smd       -0.00625  #>  7 Fold1 site      B      smd        0.00625  #>  8 Fold1 <NA>      <NA>   energy     0.0180   #>  9 Fold2 age       <NA>   smd        0.000412 #> 10 Fold2 income    <NA>   smd       -0.000580 #> # ℹ 30 more rows  random_folds <- rsample::vfold_cv(d, v = 5) balance_check(random_folds, age, income, diagnosis, site) #> # Balance check: 5 splits, max |SMD| = 0.302, mean energy distance = 0.0653 #> # A tibble: 40 × 5 #>    id    variable  level  statistic    value #>    <chr> <chr>     <chr>  <chr>        <dbl> #>  1 Fold1 age       <NA>   smd        0.00739 #>  2 Fold1 income    <NA>   smd        0.0505  #>  3 Fold1 diagnosis mild   smd       -0.257   #>  4 Fold1 diagnosis none   smd        0.302   #>  5 Fold1 diagnosis severe smd       -0.109   #>  6 Fold1 site      A      smd       -0.163   #>  7 Fold1 site      B      smd        0.163   #>  8 Fold1 <NA>      <NA>   energy     0.0878  #>  9 Fold2 age       <NA>   smd       -0.0286  #> 10 Fold2 income    <NA>   smd       -0.0968  #> # ℹ 30 more rows library(ggplot2) autoplot(balance_check(folds)) library(tune) library(parsnip)  res <- fit_resamples(   linear_reg(),   outcome ~ age + income + diagnosis,   resamples = folds ) collect_metrics(res) #> # A tibble: 2 × 6 #>   .metric .estimator  mean     n std_err .config         #>   <chr>   <chr>      <dbl> <int>   <dbl> <chr>           #> 1 rmse    standard   1.01      5 0.00969 pre0_mod0_post0 #> 2 rsq     standard   0.504     5 0.0191  pre0_mod0_post0 split <- balanced_initial_split(d, prop = 3 / 4, balance = c(age, income), method = "twinning") split #> <Training/Testing/Total> #> <300/100/400> balance_check(split) #> # Balance check: 1 split, max |SMD| = 0.0118, mean energy distance = 0.00206 #> # A tibble: 3 × 5 #>   id    variable level statistic    value #>   <chr> <chr>    <chr> <chr>        <dbl> #> 1 Split age      <NA>  smd       -0.00875 #> 2 Split income   <NA>  smd        0.0118  #> 3 Split <NA>     <NA>  energy     0.00206

text: Pass method options options. See ?balanced_vfold_cv options method. default, anticlust tries every swap, run time grows quickly number rows. one test 10 folds four variables, took 0.8 seconds 1,000 rows, 2.3 seconds 3,000 rows, 8.3 seconds 10,000 rows. k_neighbours = 20, runs took 0.2, 0.6, 1.1 seconds. Twinning took less 0.2 seconds three.

title: Balanced V-fold cross-validation — balanced_vfold_cv
text: "anticlust" (default) uses k-plus anticlustering (Papenberg, 2024) anticlust::fast_anticlustering(). makes means variances sets similar. Options : moments (default 2): highest moment balance. 1 balances means , 3 adds skewness, 4 adds kurtosis. covariances (default FALSE): also balance product pair balance columns. k_neighbours (default Inf): number nearest neighbours row may swap . Inf tries every swap. small number, 20, faster large data. local_maximum (default TRUE): repeat exchange passes pass makes swap (100 passes). FALSE runs one pass. repetitions (default 1): number random starts. best result kept. anticlust package required. "twinning" uses twinning::multiplet() folds. Options strategy (1, 2, 3; strategy 2 needs v power 2) leaf_size. v = 2, strategies 1 2 give result. Strata fewer 2 * v rows assigned random. twinning package required. "rerandomize" draws stratified random splits keeps first one whose Mahalanobis imbalance threshold (Morgan Rubin, 2012). folds, imbalance largest "one fold versus rest" comparisons. threshold p_accept quantile imbalance pilot draws made exact group constraints (max(100, min(10 / p_accept, max_draws)) draws). Draws tie threshold accepted random, acceptance rate close p_accept even discrete data. p_accept 1 / max(100, max_draws), pilot draws resolve , threshold best pilot draw. Options p_accept, target acceptance rate (default 0.1), max_draws (default 1000). draw meets threshold, best draw used warning. "interaction" cuts numeric columns quantile bins, crosses bins, stratifies random. baseline shows crossed strata become sparse. Options n_bins (default 4) pool (default 0.1): cells less fraction rows pooled.
